size_disclosure.statement: The audit (study/openidaes450, 2026-09-26) recorded the archive as 220433394 bytes, as did RELEASE_MANIFEST.json at the audited commit. The live release asset, pinned here, is 220802919 bytes: it was created and updated after the release was published and after the audited commit (timestamps above), and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json at the repository head states the pinned size. The earlier upload is therefore most likely the audited one, but the audit recorded no hash, so its bytes cannot be identified. That the pinned archive is the audited data is established only by the audit's counts reproducing (access_report.json summary).
